title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: how long an approval covers loading
content:
## Rule
Under the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product an approval is valid for loading only until the category's approval validity, in calendar days, after the acceptance was approved. The validity ends on the approval date plus the category's validity days, counted on calendar dates, and loading on that last day is covered. Goods not loaded by then return to review, as provided for amendments and re-reviews of the category. The approval date relied on is the one recorded on the acceptance.

## Step by step
1. Read the approval date recorded on the acceptance.
2. Add the category's validity days, counting calendar dates; the date reached is the last covered day.
3. Loading on or before the last covered day is covered by the approval.
4. Goods not loaded by the end of the last covered day return to review.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical validity of 12 calendar days)
| Approved on | Last covered day | Loading on | Covered by the approval |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 August | 15 August | 14 August | yes |
| 3 August | 15 August | 15 August | yes — the last day is covered |
| 3 August | 15 August | 16 August | no — the goods return to review |

## Points of judgement
- *Is the approval date itself the first of the counted days?* No. The count adds the validity days to the approval date: approved on 3 August with 12 days, the last covered day is 15 August.
- *What happens to approved goods that miss the last covered day?* They return to review.
